sources.finding: Ontario newspaper-derived index reports arrest at St. Catharines in fall 1877. Season only; original JRO 1879 clipping not read.

Catalog of signed original presidential documents dates warrant authorizing Franklin and Alderson to receive Martin Bergin to February 6, 1878. Authorization is not proof of actual transfer/admission that day.
Record of the Times July 5, 1878 transcription says brought back from Canada a year ago. Rounded account conflicts with later warrant chronology; no exact custody date inferred.
Trial references support prosecution for Patrick Burns murder; trial dates do not identify initial custody.

decision: Keep established January 16, 1879 execution. Do not convert approximate return, season-only arrest or warrant date into an exact custody start. All existing fields preserved.

next_lead.finding: Contemporary Barnwell execution report found; no initial custody date established yet.
